label: B25-BRAM-INIT-TEST-CONTRACT-REVIEW
objective: 评审 B25 BRAM init TB 的 reset-vector oracle，使 LDR literal imm19 随 link layout 变化而可验证，同时保留镜像、字节序、64-bit packing、跨 artifact 一致性、zero-fill 与 0x10000 边界覆盖。

reset_vector_oracle.meaning: The debug word is eight little-endian bytes: LDR X0 literal word 0x580017c0 followed by ADD/MOV SP,X0 word 0x9100001f.
reset_vector_oracle.problem: 0x580017c0 contains an imm19-derived PC-relative offset. Any link/layout movement of the literal pool changes the whole 64-bit constant even if the reset semantics remain correct.
reset_vector_oracle.decision: Reject as the long-term oracle; retain only as a temporary smoke diagnostic if labeled non-authoritative.

coverage_gaps.wrong_or_missing_image: partial: a wrong first word fails the constant, but missing/wrong path and full-image hash are not explicit and simulator $readmemh diagnostics are not a contract
coverage_gaps.byte_order: partial: only bytes 0..7 are indirectly checked
coverage_gaps.byte_lane_and_64bit_packing: missing: no full BIN/HEX/MIF word/lane cross-check
coverage_gaps.hex_bin_mif_identity: missing: TB consumes HEX only and never reads BIN/MIF
coverage_gaps.zero_fill: partial: one debug read at 0xF000 is checked, not all padding/stack words
coverage_gaps.exclusive_top_boundary: present: 0xFFFC/0xFFFF accepted and 0x10000 faults; cross-boundary matrix is incomplete
coverage_gaps.dut_independence: current constant is not derived from DUT/debug, but a future oracle must explicitly reject using DUT output to generate expected data

approach_comparison.strength: minimal edit and immediate smoke coverage
approach_comparison.weakness: freezes link-dependent imm19 and only observes one word; does not prove HEX/BIN/MIF or zero-fill

approach_comparison.strength: layout changes can be reflected automatically if generated from ELF
approach_comparison.weakness: stale include/build-cache risk; if generated from boot.hex or boot.mif it is circular and cannot detect a common wrong image
approach_comparison.condition: may carry derived expected fields, but must be hash-bound and never be the sole oracle

approach_comparison.approach: TB runtime read of independent expected file
approach_comparison.strength: avoids compile-time hardcoding and allows a fresh expected artifact per image
approach_comparison.weakness: independence is false if expected file is copied from DUT HEX/MIF; requires a manifest/hash gate and explicit missing-file failure

approach_comparison.strength: decodes ELF/load bytes and LDR imm19 semantics, then checks complete BIN/HEX/MIF byte/lane/zero-fill identity
approach_comparison.weakness: more implementation work, but the check is deterministic and reusable for physical MIF provenance
approach_comparison.recommended_composition: Use this approach to generate/hash an independent expected image; let TB runtime-load that file and retain boundary requests.

recommended_contract.oracle_source: boot.elf load segments and symbols, parsed independently from DUT debug output and not by rereading boot.hex/boot.mif as the expected source
structural_checks: Require ELF AArch64 entry _start=0 and load bytes within the 64 KiB BRAM image window.

Decode word 0 as 64-bit LDR-literal with Rt=X0; extract imm19, sign-extend the PC-relative byte offset, resolve the literal target in the ELF image, and require the loaded literal value equals symbol __stack_top (0x10000). Do not compare a fixed imm19 or fixed 64-bit reset word.
Decode word 1 structurally as ADD-immediate alias MOV SP,X0 with sf=1, Rn=X0, Rd=SP, shift=0 and imm12=0; do not rely on the first word's layout.
Generate a separate expected byte image from the independently parsed ELF load segments, padded to exactly 0x10000 bytes.
cross_artifact_checks: boot.bin equals the ELF-derived load image and does not exceed 0x10000 bytes.
boot.hex parses to exactly the same bytes as boot.bin; missing, empty, malformed or extra bytes fail.
boot.mif has WIDTH=64, DEPTH=8192, exactly 8192 explicit records, and little-endian word bytes equal boot.bin plus zero padding.
Hash ELF/BIN/HEX/MIF, expected file and source SHA in one manifest before compiling the TB.
recommended_contract.tb_consumer: Add an expected-image path/parameter and runtime-read the independently generated expected bytes; assemble expected debug words from expected_mem[addr+i] rather than a hardcoded 64-bit reset constant.
recommended_contract.non_circularity_rule: Never generate expected bytes by reading lcvex_bram_boot.dbg_rdata or by copying the DUT's HEX/MIF; a checker must fail when the expected file is missing or hash-mismatched.
